---
title: "Scheduling workflows"
---

## Purpose

The scheduler creates local recurring alarms for an ODK/Kobo form or online web form. It supports daily, weekly, monthly and nth-weekday rules, notification reminders and configurable retry intervals.

The intended round trip is:

```text
ResearchOS scheduler
    → launches the relevant form
    → the form invokes ResearchOS
    → ResearchOS executes a specialist method
    → the result returns to the form
```

## Distinguish scheduling from form launch

The ODK form launcher opens a selected form and observes its return. The scheduler decides when a target should be launched.

See:

- [Scheduler capability](capabilities/scheduler-capability.qmd)
- [ODK form launcher](capabilities/odk-form-launcher.qmd)

## Field testing

Scheduled workflows should be tested on the actual device model because Android background restrictions vary by manufacturer.

Test at least:

- device unlocked and locked;
- ResearchOS in the background;
- notifications permitted and denied;
- airplane mode;
- device restart;
- the EDC already open;
- recurring schedules;
- retry behaviour.

## Schedule transfer

The supplied scheduler documentation also defines RIL schedule export and import, including transfer through QR or NFC dependency boundaries.
